This individual was the '''commander''' of the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Desolator (Imperial-class)/Legends|''Desolator'']] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In [[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]], this individual commnaded the force that was sent to [[Battle of Yag'Dhul (Imperial era)|attack]] a [[Yag'Dhul insurgents|group of insurgents]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Yag'Dhul/Legends|Yag'Dhul]].
